design_philosophy: Modular, extensible architecture with clear separation of concerns, prioritizing MVP for beginner developers.

phases.description: Minimum Viable Product (MVP) for core conversational AI and mock tests.

modules.name: Presentation Layer
modules.description: Handles all user interface rendering and interaction.

modules.name: Application Logic Core
modules.description: Orchestrates core business logic, AI interactions, and user management.
responsibilities: Detect user intent and route requests
Assemble AI prompts and interact with LLM
Generate mock tests and score results
Infer weak topics from chat history

modules.name: Knowledge Content Integration
modules.description: Manages access to GATE material, question banks, and content sources.
responsibilities: Perform semantic search on GATE material
Retrieve and rerank relevant content chunks
Access and provide question bank data

modules.name: Data Persistence
modules.description: Manages all application data storage and retrieval operations.
responsibilities: Store user profiles and session data
Save mock test questions and results
Store GATE material metadata and question bank

phases.description: Advanced features including personalized learning, rich media, and community.

modules.name: Advanced Learning Engine
modules.description: Provides personalized study plans, adaptive tests, and retention systems.
responsibilities: Manage flashcard generation and spaced repetition

modules.name: Multimodal Interaction Processor
modules.description: Enables voice, image, and document-based interactions with the AI.
responsibilities: Process voice input for AI interaction
Extract and interpret content from PDFs

modules.name: Platform Management Services
modules.description: Supports administrative tasks, community features, and gamification.
responsibilities: Generate detailed progress and performance reports

unified_data_contract.name: GateSter Unified Data Contract
unified_data_contract.description: Canonical data model for all application modules and persistence.

fields.name: activeSessionId
fields.description: Identifier for the user's current active session.

fields.name: messageHistory
fields.description: Ordered list of chat messages in a conversation.

fields.name: mockTestId
fields.description: Unique identifier for a mock test instance.

fields.name: testResultData
fields.description: Structured data representing a user's mock test performance.

fields.name: learningProgress
fields.description: Aggregated data on user's learning status and weak topics.
